60 Minutes’ Lesley Stahl travels to Albuquerque, New Mexico, where AeroVironment’s laser system, called Locust, is being built. The laser fires a concentrated light beam, capable of destroying drones.

Each unit costs about $8 million and can be installed on a fixed site or mounted in the back of a truck.

CEO Wahid Nawabi says the laser system has been used in multiple battles around the world, but it is not being used in the current war against Iran. | 60 Minutes | Facebook
